question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The correct answer is: **Stetionery** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correct spelling of the word should be '**Stationery**'. • The word refers to writing materials such as paper, envelopes, pens, pencils, etc. (लेखन सामग्री जैसे कागज, लिफाफे, पेन, पेंसिल आदि) • **Example**: *I need to buy some stationery for my office, including pens, notebooks, and sticky notes.* • The incorrect spelling '**Stetionery**' may cause confusion and miscommunication in written communication. • It is important to double-check spellings before using them in official or formal documents. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**. (बेचैनी, चिंता या भय की भावना) • **Preparation **refers to the act of getting ready for something. (किसी चीज़ के लिए तैयार होने की क्रिया या भाव) • **Voluntary **means done, given, or acting of one's own free will.
